title: tailwind_docs Docker Multi-Stage Build Config
description: Optimized multi-stage Dockerfile for lightweight node web service and Python FastAPI uvicorn production builds from tailwind_docs.
code:
# Dataset Reference: tailwind_docs
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app/tailwind_docs
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=builder /app/tailwind_docs/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 80
